name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing multiple concurrent stable branches alongside a beta track. The current latest stable release is v0.62.4 (OSS) / v1.62.4 (Enterprise), released on July 8, 2025, with v0.63.0-beta also available for testing (not recommended for production). Multiple older branches (58.x, 59.x, 60.x, 61.x) continue to receive patch updates, indicating long-term support across several versions. Release notes and downloads are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition has a commercial license. Both are available as separate builds.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several stable branches were published in late June and early July 2025, with a beta (v0.63.0) also active.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase offers a managed cloud (Metabase Cloud) at https://www.metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported as Enterprise/Pro features.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: Supports a wide range of databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB, Druid, Oracle, Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, and more (exact list varies by version and edition).

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Offers far more advanced visualizations and enterprise features than Metabase but comes with significant licensing costs and no open-source option.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Tightly integrated with dbt for a metrics-layer-first approach, making it more structured than Metabase but requiring a dbt workflow as a prerequisite.
